_comment: Tier-2 for sparta axisymmetric: there is no 'global ... axisymmetric' keyword; axisymmetry is the boundary letter 'a' on the LOWER y face only, so the single-letter 'boundary p a p' is always an error and the two-letter 'boundary o ar p' is required. Feeds eight wrong variants to the binary and matches each error string, confirms both correct forms run, and shows the 2d-only restriction is checked at RUN SETUP — a 3d deck with 'boundary o ar p' and no 'run' exits 0. COVERS (added 2026-08-06): four claims, all executed by this script's own eight wrong variants — axisymmetric:0 (no 'global ... axisymmetric' keyword, update.cpp:1805), :1 (single-letter 'a', domain.cpp:176), :2 (ylo!=0, y-periodic, and the 2d check deferred to run setup), and :3 (both 'global weight cell radius' ordering constraints, grid.cpp:1997 and grid.cpp:1983). :3 is co-verified by axisymmetric_weight_radius_and_bad_moves but attributed here, where it was executed first, so it is not counted twice.
